title: Events: an Add an event box closes the page, a lead capture for visitors
detail: Owner list 2026-10-19 item 12. EventsAddBox sits above the hub doors. Any signed-in member sees New event (plus Drafts and Manage once they have an event); a visitor sees Sign up to host and Log in (back to /events/new) with three plain steps. The More in Events chip row stays below it because the nav coverage guard requires every hub body to draw its hub links.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const b=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/events/events-body.tsx','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-events.css','utf8');const x=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/events/events-add-box.tsx','utf8');if(!b.includes('<EventsAddBox'))bad.push('page does not draw the box');if(!/\/join/.test(x)||!/sign-in\?next=/.test(x))bad.push('visitor lead capture lost its sign up or log in door');if(!/\/events\/new/.test(x))bad.push('member create door lost');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1016: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Add an event box is not drawn or loses the visitor sign up and log in doors or the member create door.
